name: Oomiwa Rui
source: A shrine maiden from the Seitenguu. She's a friend of [url=/c17039]Corona’s[/url] who is in charge of the local shrine. She often sleeps in strange places and has a notoriously poor memory due to “burning them to stay warm”.
translation: A shrine maiden from the Seitenguu. She's a friend of [url=/c17039]Corona’s[/url] who is in charge of the local shrine. She often sleeps in strange places and has a notoriously poor memory due to “burning them to stay warm”.
